meta.title: Messaging runtime: three apps, one durable store

cards.title: Inside EACH Go process
items: One outbox publisher, Redis listener and bounded lease-batch worker.
Four shared-feed refresh workers; one 1 s durable sweep.
Authenticated HTTP handlers; per-socket reader, writer and catch-up.
Workers are goroutines inside app1, app2 and app3, not another service.

cards.title: Recovery ownership
items: Device owns its last successfully processed contiguous cursor.
Client: HTTP initial/reconnect/gap repair; capped jittered reconnect.
Server: 1 s durable sweep; fixed subscriptions share repair after negotiation.
Replies and WS events return through Nginx; no direct device-to-store access.

cards.title: Default profile bounds and authorization
items: Each app: 32 SQL connections, 1,000 sockets, 100 handshake attempts/s.
128 live feeds, 128 messages/feed, four workers and 128 queued jobs.
128 outbound events/socket; full queues or write timeout close the socket.
Bearer identity is local mock configuration; membership gates conversation access.

cards.title: Durability and single points of failure
items: Send success follows PostgreSQL COMMIT of message, sequence and outbox.
Redis never acknowledges durable sends; missed hints recover from history.
One PostgreSQL instance/volume: no configured database failover.
One Redis instance: presence/live setup unavailable on outage; history still works if PostgreSQL is healthy.
One Nginx and one Docker host are additional shared failure points.

cards.title: Scope and evidence
items: Arrows show ingress and dependencies; Go replicas are grouped because they run identical code.
Code-inspected working files; implementation-evidence.json records paths, ranges and SHA-256 hashes.
Uncommitted working-file review; Git-pinned source verification is not claimed.
Scale profile overrides: 12,000 sockets, 512 feeds, 500 handshakes/s per app.
